summary.en: Big matches mean crowded gates before and after play. Meet by block or enclosure and leave together.

detail.en: Stadiums sell seats by block letter (Eden Gardens) or named enclosure (Gaddafi Stadium). Save yours as a meeting point.
Pick a gate on the side you will leave from, and a fixed spot a little away from it.

name.en: Your car, bus or rickshaw stand

detail.en: Save it before you go in.

dos.en: Arrive early and know your gate and block before you queue.
After the match, wait for the first rush to clear before you leave.
Venues can change late: check the official schedule on match day.
Find the exits and a second way out as soon as you arrive.
In a dense crowd, keep your hands up near your chest to protect your breathing.
Move with the flow and work your way diagonally toward the edge.

donts.en: Don't join a crowd outside the gates for victory celebrations: a crush at Chinnaswamy Stadium in Bengaluru killed 11 people in June 2025.
Don't go to the stadium without a ticket hoping to get in.
Don't push against the flow of a crowd, and don't stop or sit down in it.
Don't stand against walls, fences or barricades when a crowd is dense.

detail.en: The PCB confirmed 18 March to 2 May 2027 for PSL 12. Venues were not announced at the time of writing.
The 2027 schedule had not been announced at the time of writing.

checklist.en: Every group member has the app, has joined the group and has filled in their emergency card.
Block or enclosure and an outside gate saved as meeting points.
